{{Top|leg}}
A '''mechanic tool kit''' was a specialized [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]] used by [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]]. The [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Barada/Legends|Barada]] utilized a mechanic tool kit while serving [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
